description: Two-day power failure at the Hong Kong sourcing office delayed PO confirmations
lessons_learned: Backup power for the sourcing office
assumptions_wrong: Assumed the fallback process was tested; it was not

assumptions_wrong: Assumed the fallback process was tested; it was not

description: Port workers strike plus a yard crane failure left ships queuing up to 19 days; Bangladesh-origin kids babywear and outerwear arrived late and stocked out online and in stores
root_cause: Port workers wage strike combined with a yard crane failure; vessel queue of 9 days
lessons_learned: Hold 6 weeks safety stock on top kids lines; pre-agree air freight rates; split Bangladesh volume across ports
assumptions_wrong: Port throughput 25% not 70%; delays 19 days not 5; only 35% of volume could fly, at 2.4x rates; safety stock covered 2.1 weeks not 4

incident_name: Electronics battery batch recall at SUP-0048
description: Defective rechargeable battery batch in personal care and smart home lines forced a withdrawal and rework
root_cause: Quality control gap on a new production line at SUP-0048
lessons_learned: Tighten supplier audits and require batch testing on new lines
assumptions_wrong: ISO certification did not mean zero defects; actual defect rate 2.5%

incident_name: Ocean carrier capacity shortage and rate spike
description: Peak-season carrier capacity shortage on Asia-UK lanes led to rate hikes and spot market exposure
root_cause: Vessel breakdown cascade across a carrier fleet
assumptions_wrong: Carriers kept a 15% capacity buffer; actual no buffer during the peak
